review:
A superhero on paylines: Spinman's symbol expands into a full Justice Reel wild whenever it would complete a win. Each expansion spins a Booster Wheel for one of six multipliers between 2x and 500x – or an instant max win – and several Justice Reels add together.

Beyond the three normal bonuses there's a Hidden Epic Bonus, Reel Heroes, that can't be bought and only triggers naturally. That makes ordinary spins a bit more exciting. 10,000x max.
